parsed.main_gap: The set Q is defined incorrectly; it must contain all primes at most A, not merely those dividing A. With that one correction, the proof works.

errors.description: For the stated Q, the claim σ(x)=P(x) when all prime factors of x are at most A is false, so the key lemma and periodicity fail. For A=15, x=18 is a term but σ(18)={3} is not good since it misses P(20). Replacing Q by all primes ≤A repairs the argument throughout.

parsed.notes: This appears to be a definition-level transcription error: later arguments and the falsification discussion explicitly use all primes at most A. After that uniform replacement, the induction and translation-periodicity argument are complete.
